tools.name: policy_profile.switch
tools.description: Switch the active safety policy profile (bring-up or steady). Human, non-root tokens only.

profile.description: Target profile name: bring-up or steady.

tools.name: feed.read
tools.description: Read feed-visible events. Provider HTTP returns the provider_safe_feed.v1 structural projection without raw event payloads. Default: snapshot (newest first). Pass cursor and/or wait (Go duration, e.g. 30s) for watcher mode — same contract as GET /v1/feed (oldest-first page, next_cursor, has_more). scope=assigned and exclude_actor translate into the same normalized filter contract REST uses; filtered cursors are identity-bound and fail closed on mismatch.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior next_cursor or SSE id. Omit for snapshot mode.

exclude_actor.description: Optional actor exclusions: "self" or a token id, repeatable — same contract as REST exclude_actor. Malformed values fail the call closed.

scope.description: Optional. "assigned" selects the reducing assigned/addressed lane — same contract as REST scope=assigned. Assigned-only tokens are normalized onto this lane automatically.

wait.description: Long-poll cap as a Go duration (e.g. 10s). Use with watcher semantics; server-capped.

tools.name: backlog.readiness
tools.description: Summarize the complete visible backlog from the work_items projection.

limit.description: Deprecated compatibility argument (0-200); readiness always scans the complete visible backlog.

tools.name: projections.define

filter.description: Feed filter object: {kinds, kind_classes}. Admin kinds/classes are refused.

idempotency_key.description: Required idempotency key for MCP mutation calls. Reuse only for the same tool arguments.

rootstock.description: Whether this definition is immutable rootstock.

type.description: Projection type. Only feed is accepted; defaults to feed.

version.description: Version. Starts at 1; existing names require current+1.
